messages:
laura: FYI caught a customer bug where their metrics show v2 token usage but logs show v1 for the same websocket session. Looks like routing fallback + client's implicit expectations are colliding.

anil: That's from the fallback policy we enabled: if v2 capacity is tight, we fall back to v1 for latency SLOs. Problem is the switch happens mid-session and billing attributes to whichever variant processes the token.

rita: Could we add a negotiation header that signals "pin preference" from client side? Something like `X-Redwood-Pin-Mode: prefer-sticky|stateless|sticky-for=<s>` so SDKs can tell server how to handle affinity.

devex-jamie: Love the header idea. Also think Console should expose a per-tenant toggle "compatibility billing mode" that, when enabled, forces attribution to initial variant for a configurable window. Docs + billing FAQ need to clarify.

laura: Telemetry ask: emit `compat.attribution_decision` with fields (tenant, route, decision, reason, session_hint) at low-cardinality. We can then link spikes in the billing graph to decision reasons (fallback, manual unpin, autoscale).

anil: Implementation notes: 1) add header negotiator in routing layer; 2) emit attribution event; 3) add backend dedupe that prefers origin variant when session_cookie or header present for N seconds; 4) console toggle behind feature flag.

sre-bot: alert: high-attribution-jitter detected on route /generate for tenant: gamma-ops (+9% 1h)

rita: UX: console banner during rollout should show "compat mode active" with hover explainers and a link to run a guided test that opens a synthetic websocket and shows expected attribution. Make it friendly for integrators.

devex-jamie: I'll add SDK helpers to optionally set `X-Redwood-Pin-Mode` and to auto-generate a `migration_session_id`. Also will draft migration checklist for customers migrating to v2.

laura: Ops need: an admin debug endpoint `/internal/debug/attribution?token=...` and a reconciliation export job that compares runtime attribution vs billing ledger for flagged tenants. Admin-only.

anil: We'll gate the dedupe logic behind `compat.attribution_grace` FF and default to 30s. Also add a metric `compat.attribution_backfill_count` so engineering can watch for backfills.

rita: One more: for Dedicated/Private customers we should default compat mode ON during early rollout windows and expose explicit opt-out in Console so they get predictable invoices.

sre-bot: deploy: canary apply -> infra-canary-3 (sha: d4f7b2)

laura: Thanks folks. Action items: Rita mock console banner + guided test, Anil PR for header + FF, Jamie SDK helper + docs, I'll add telemetry schema and reconciliation job ticket.

devex-jamie: Will coordinate copy with legal for billing wording.

laura: Great. Let's sync tomorrow after initial canary telemetry.
